identificationModule.briefTitle: Evaluation of G-CSF (Colony Stimulating Factor) in Patients With Chronic Chagas Cardiomyopathy
identificationModule.officialTitle: Prospective, Double-blind, Randomized, Placebo-controlled Phase II Clinical Trial for Evaluation of G-CSF in Patients With Chronic Chagas Cardiomyopathy

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the effectiveness of treatment with G-CSF in patients with chronic heart failure secondary to Chagas disease.

armGroups.label: G-CSF
armGroups.description: Subjects will be randomly assigned to receive treatment with G-CSF (10mg/kg/day) for five days, during 4 cicles.
interventionNames: Drug: Treatment with G-CSF (Granulocyte colony stimulating factor)

armGroups.label: Saline
armGroups.description: Subjects will be randomly assigned to receive saline for five days, during 4 cicles.

interventions.name: Treatment with G-CSF (Granulocyte colony stimulating factor)
interventions.description: Subjects will be randomly assigned to receive treatment with G-CSF (10mg/kg/day) for five days, during 4 cicles.

interventions.name: Placebo saline
interventions.description: Subjects will be randomly assigned to receive treatment saline for five days, during 4 cicles.

primaryOutcomes.measure: NYHA (New York Heart Association) functional class improvement
primaryOutcomes.description: All patients will undergo periodic clinical evaluations in order to identify improvement on NYHA classification for heart failure.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 6, 9 and 12 months after the therapy with G-CSF

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Assessment of cardiovascular function measured by transthoracic echocardiography
secondaryOutcomes.description: All patients will be submitted to echocardiography after 6 and 12 months to assess improvements on ventricular function.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Assessment of cardiovascular function measured by cardiac magnetic resonance imaging
secondaryOutcomes.description: All patients will be submitted to a second cardiac magnetic resonance, after 12 months, to assess improvements on left ventricular ejection fraction.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Evaluation of functional capacity assessed by treadmill test and by 6-minute walk test
secondaryOutcomes.description: All patients will be submitted to a second treadmill test and 6-minute walk test after 12 months to assess improvement on functional capacity.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Evaluation of improvement of quality of life
secondaryOutcomes.description: All patients will respond to Minnesota Questionnaire to have an evaluation of quality of life after 6 and 12 months.
All patients will be submitted to complete blood counts in several time frames in order to evaluate tolerability to G-CSF injection.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 1, 5, 13, 17, 25, 29, 37 and 41 days and 3, 6, 9 and 12 months after the therapy
